title: Ben Jepson
text:
I build reproducible statistical tools and analysis for regulated manufacturing, with a focus on SPC, DOE, capability analysis, and practical visual methods. My work centers on clarity, correctness, and helping real people solve real problems with data.

title: About
text:
Hello!
I’m a statistician who likes to figure things out. I focus on data analysis that helps solve real problems and supports good decision making, especially in regulated manufacturing environments.
My background spans food science, product development, and industrial statistics. I’ve worked across R&D, process engineering, and corporate statistics, and I discovered early on that statistics was the most powerful tool I had for improving processes, understanding variation, and helping teams make better choices.
Over the years I’ve worked with many types of data and many analytical methods:

exploratory analysis and visualization

experimental design and statistical process control

measurement systems analysis

multivariate analysis and clustering

industrial analytics and capability studies

I earned an MS in Applied Statistics from KUMC while working full time, and I’ve been an R user for over a decade. Today, I focus on reproducible statistical tools and analysis that effectively answer the question at hand and enable faster learning and process improvement.
I’m currently developing an SPC package in R that reflects the practical needs I’ve seen in manufacturing: clarity, correctness, metadata, and opinionated defaults that help users avoid common pitfalls.
Outside of work, I enjoy planting trees, gardening, and playing guitar.
